Task: Structured Document Extraction

Write Python code that normalizes extracted expense fields into a standard JSON schema using one concrete third-party managed service or hosted API.

output_text:
import json
import os
from google.cloud import documentai_v1 as documentai

def process_expense_document(project_id: str, location: str, processor_id: str, file_path: str) -> dict:
    """
    Processes an expense document using Google Cloud Document AI and normalizes the output.
    """
    # Create a client
    client = documentai.DocumentProcessorServiceClient()

    # The full resource name of the processor
    # e.g.: projects/project_id/locations/location/processors/processor_id
    name = client.processor_path(project_id, location, processor_id)

    # Read the file into memory
    with open(file_path, "rb") as image_file:
        content = image_file.read()

    # Configure the process request
    document = documentai.Document(content=content, mime_type="application/pdf")

    request = documentai.ProcessRequest(name=name, document=document)

    # Process the document
    result = client.process_document(request=request)
    document = result.document

    # Initialize a dictionary for normalized expense data
    normalized_expense = {
        "items": [],
        "total_amount": None,
        "currency": None,
        "expense_date": None,
        "merchant_name": None,
        "category": None
    }

    # Extract top-level expense fields
    for entity in document.entities:
        if entity.type_ == "total_amount" and entity.mention_text:
            normalized_expense["total_amount"] = float(entity.mention_text)
            if entity.normalized_value and entity.normalized_value.currency_value:
                normalized_expense["currency"] = entity.normalized_value.currency_value.currency_code
        elif entity.type_ == "expense_date" and entity.mention_text:
            normalized_expense["expense_date"] = entity.normalized_value.date_value.iso_date if entity.normalized_value and entity.normalized_value.date_value else entity.mention_text
        elif entity.type_ == "merchant_name" and entity.mention_text:
            normalized_expense["merchant_name"] = entity.mention_text
        elif entity.type_ == "category" and entity.mention_text:
            normalized_expense["category"] = entity.mention_text

    # Extract line items
    for entity in document.entities:
        if entity.type_ == "line_item":
            item = {
                "description": None,
                "amount": None,
                "quantity": None,
                "unit_price": None
            }
            for prop in entity.properties:
                if prop.type_ == "line_item/description" and prop.mention_text:
                    item["description"] = prop.mention_text
                elif prop.type_ == "line_item/amount" and prop.mention_text:
                    item["amount"] = float(prop.mention_text)
                elif prop.type_ == "line_item/quantity" and prop.mention_text:
                    item["quantity"] = float(prop.mention_text)
                elif prop.type_ == "line_item/unit_price" and prop.mention_text:
                    item["unit_price"] = float(prop.mention_text)
            if item["description"] or item["amount"]: # Only add if it has meaningful data
                normalized_expense["items"].append(item)

    return normalized_expense
